headline: ROBOT LAB stage 3: the arm earns its physics
lede: The robot arm is now torque-driven — real τ limits, gravity sag, and a grip you can actually lose.

notes.text: Torque-driven joints: effort % + saturation readouts live in the HUD; fast whips lag, heavy carries sag.
Force-closure grasp from the 2F-85 SimReady record: slam cargo into the drawer lip and it SLIPS (counter in HUD). Too-heavy picks are refused at the grab.
Wrist camera: press C for the gripper's-eye PIP with crosshair.
robokitcheck now 13 gates and wired into CI for real (stages 1–2 shipped the alias unwired); mutant-proven — soften the shoulder torque and four gates go red.
